description: Defines the LoanTransactionToRepaymentScheduleMapping entity class, which maps loan transactions to repayment schedule installments, including component amounts such as principal, interest, fees, and penalties.

classes.name: LoanTransactionToRepaymentScheduleMapping
classes.description: Entity class representing the mapping between a loan transaction and a repayment schedule installment, including component amounts and related methods.

methods.name: createFrom
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance from loan transaction, installment, and component amounts in Money form.

methods.name: updateComponents
methods.description: Updates the component amounts with new Money values.

methods.name: updateAmount
methods.description: Recalculates the total amount based on component parts.

methods.name: setComponents
methods.description: Sets component amounts directly and updates total.

methods.name: getPrincipalPortion
methods.description: Returns the principal portion as Money.

methods.name: getInterestPortion
methods.description: Returns the interest portion as Money.

methods.name: getFeeChargesPortion
methods.description: Returns the fee charges portion as Money.

methods.name: getPenaltyChargesPortion
methods.description: Returns the penalty charges portion as Money.

methods.name: isZeroAmount
methods.description: Checks if the total amount is zero or null.
